messages:
incident-bot: AUTO-PAGER -> @oncall-ml (S2) tenant-specific quality alert for tenant `odin-tech` on dedicated pool `dedicated-apac-1`. Nightly monitor shows rouge drop: evaluation Q-score -21% after quant profile promotion at 10:15 UTC. Sample set 40/80 degraded. Please ack.

oncall-ml: acking. Oncall here. @eng-ml-ana did we promote a new quant profile to odin-tech?

eng-ml-ana: we rolled `q4_int8_calib_v2` to odin routing at 10:15 as part of targeted perf rollout. Global canaries passed but we didn't run a tenant long-context smoke for odin. Pulling request logs and recent llm traces now.

sre-kate: confirm customer impact: are requests failing, or is this purely quality? Any SLA concerns?

oncall-ml: quality-only (semantic drift, summary omissions). No 5xx, no CPU/GPU saturation. Support reports a priority ticket from Odin.

support-lin: Odin message: "We see our automated QA flagging summaries as incorrect; blocking our nightly QA gating. Please advise ETA." They've asked for a rollback.

eng-ml-ana: because Odin is on a dedicated pool we can do a tenant-scoped rollback to the safe profile `q3_fp16_compat`. Proposed rapid mitigation: 1) pin their model config back to q3_fp16_compat; 2) run a 180-sample on their recent traffic snapshot; 3) monitor user-facing metrics for 15 minutes; 4) keep pin in place until recalibration completed.

ops-rolf: send patch payload and I'll apply via control plane. Will run canary apply for tenant only and watch autoscaler + cache behavior.

eng-ml-ana: control plane PATCH payload: 

```
PATCH /v1/tenants/odin-tech/model-config
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model_variant": "redwood-7b-v3",
  "quant_profile": "q3_fp16_compat",
  "pin_until": "2026-03-22T12:00:00Z",
  "rollback_reason": "tenant-specific quality regression after q4_int8_calib_v2 rollout"
}
```

or if on-prem: 

```
kubectl -n odin-tech patch modelconfig odin-model --type=merge -p '{"spec":{"quantProfile":"q3_fp16_compat"}}'
```

ops-rolf: applying tenant-scoped patch now (canary). Running a dry-run first.

incident-bot: control-plane dry-run ok. Canary apply submitted at 10:28 UTC. Canary regression job id: reg-9001 (180 samples).

support-lin: notified customer: "We identified a quantization change likely responsible. Rolling back your tenant profile now; will confirm after verification (~20min)." Odin acknowledged.

eng-ml-ana: earliest canary delta: 180 samples show avg quality delta improved to -0.6% (from -21%). Hallucination rate returned to baseline.

ops-rolf: promoting patch to full tenant routing at 10:42 UTC. Control plane returned 200 OK. Applying smart-routing override to avoid cross-tenant cache incompatibility.

oncall-ml: rerouting command: 

```
redis-cli HSET smart-routing:odin-tech model_variant redwood-7b-v3:q3_fp16_compat
```

ops-rolf: override applied. KV cache warm-up showed small spike in misses but settled within SLO. No autoscaler thrash observed.

sre-kate: logging incident INC-2026-ODIN-9. Preliminary RCA: q4_int8_calib_v2's calibration assumptions (context length distribution & structured prompts) didn't match Odin's workload, causing token-level quantization errors.

eng-ml-ana: follow-ups opened: 1) add tenant-specific long-context smoke tests to the rollout pipeline; 2) require a tenant sample check for any future quant promotions to dedicated pools; 3) retrain calibration for q4_int8_calib_v2 using an Odin sample subset.

support-lin: customer update: "Roll back confirmed, quality restored. Please share postmortem and ETA for permanent fix." They've requested a brief postmortem and timeline.

oncall-ml: handing off to @sre-kate for postmortem write-up and tracking long-term remediations. Handoff summary: 
- Impact: Odin experienced quality regression on dedicated pool after q4_int8_calib_v2 at 10:15 UTC
- Mitigation: tenant-scoped rollback to q3_fp16_compat by 10:42 UTC; canary eval passed
- Customer: notified and acknowledged; quality restored
- Next steps: eng-ml to recalibrate q4 using tenant distribution; infra to add tenant-targeted pre-deploy checks

sre-kate: taking ownership. Will coordinate with eng-ml-ana to produce postmortem and assign remediation owners. Closing thread once PM published.

oncall-ml: thanks everyone, great quick ops. :thumbsup:
